source.label: Where to read what is playing from. Each needs its own setup, in the group with its name below

options.lastfm: Last.fm (Spotify, YouTube Music and most players, a few seconds late)
options.tuna: Tuna, the OBS plugin (on this PC, instant)
options.pear: Pear Desktop, for YouTube Music (on this PC, instant)

pollSeconds.label: How often to ask, in seconds (3 to 60)

lastfmKey.label: Your Last.fm API key (a free one, from last.fm/api/account/create). Anyone who can see this overlay's address can see the key

tunaPort.label: The port Tuna's web server uses (its setting, 1608 unless you changed it)

pearPort.label: The port Pear Desktop's API Server uses (26538 unless you changed it)

pearToken.label: Pear Desktop's access token, only if its API Server is not set to no authentication. Leave blank otherwise

spotifyRefreshToken.label: Your Spotify refresh token, from the sign-in page described in this overlay's README. It lets anyone who sees this overlay's address read what you play, so do not share the address

command.label: Command word. Moderators and you type it with off, on or refresh

whoCanManage.label: Who can hide and show the card

showProgress.label: Show how far through the track it is (only where the source says: not Last.fm)

labelPlaying.label: The small line above the title while it plays (blank for none)

showPaused.label: Keep showing the track while it is paused

labelPaused.label: The small line above the title while it is paused (blank for none)

idleText.label: What to say when nothing is playing. Blank hides the card instead

textSize.label: Text size, as a percent of the box's width

titleScale.label: How big the title is next to the artist (1 is the same)

artSize.label: How big the album art is, in lines of text

themePreset.label: Style preset (the same twenty-two are in every overlay in this set)

fontFamily.label: Font (used when the style preset is Custom)

outerFrame.label: An outer frame round the widget in the accent colour, or the flag's stripes in a pride preset. Untick it for none

borderWidth.label: Frame and outline thickness in pixels. At 0 the frame has a default thickness that grows with the box, and with the frame unticked there is no outline

borderColor.label: Outline colour, used when the outer frame is unticked and the thickness is above 0 (the frame itself is always the accent colour)

fit.label: Shrink the card to fit the box: when the box is too short for it, it gets smaller instead of running off the bottom

colorPanel.label: Panel colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

panelOpacity.label: Panel opacity, 0 to 1 (used when the style preset is Custom)

cText.label: Text (used when the style preset is Custom)

cAccent.label: Accent: the rotating line and the pronoun tag text (used when the style preset is Custom)

cTrack.label: The pronoun tag's background (used when the style preset is Custom)

cWarn.label: Alert colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

btnHide.label: Hide the card (the same as the off command)

btnShow.label: Show the card (the same as the on command)

showProblems.label: Show a note on the card when the source cannot be read. Switch it on while you set up, and off for stream

debug.label: Log every event to the browser-source console
